description: Probe inputs generated by tools/gen_probe_inputs.py from vectors/vectors.json (do not edit by hand). 'inputs' has one entry per vector ('vector' = vector id; 's' = input string; expect/profile/options/requires/checks copied from the vector); 'legacy' keeps the original 2026-09-24 probe strings that have no byte-identical vector. Legacy probe programs read inputs + legacy; run_vectors.py adapters (probes/README.md) get the vectors directly.

categories.valid: grammar-valid RFC 3339 date-time; accept with the same instant
categories.ext: space separator: RFC 3339 §5.6 NOTE lets applications choose it (legacy)
categories.range: grammar-valid but outside many engines' range (year 0000); reject = too strict (range)
categories.leap-real: a real leap second; reject = too strict (no leap second)
categories.leap-fake: second 60 where no leap second can be; accept = too lenient
categories.ixdtf-ok: valid IXDTF suffix; an RFC 3339-only consumer should reject
categories.ixdtf-reject: IXDTF string a consumer MUST reject
categories.ixdtf-may: RFC 9557 permits either verdict (suffix); records the target's choice
categories.either: RFC permits either verdict (see interpretation); records the target's choice
categories.option: verdict depends on a non-default option (see options); legacy analyzers skip it
